'# The following code to create a dataframe and remove duplicated rows is always executed and acts as a preamble for your script: 

# dataset <- data.frame(county_name, average_salary, avg_price_m2)
# dataset <- unique(dataset)

# Paste or type your script code here:
# === R SCRIPT: Kinnisvarahindade ja Keskmise Palga Seose Efektne Visuaal ===
# See skript loob professionaalse ja efektse animeeritud ning staatilise mullidiagrammi, 
# mis näitab ruutmeetri hinna ja keskmise palga dünaamikat Eesti maakondades läbi aastate.

# 1. Vajalike pakettide laadimine
# Installeeri enne käivitamist: install.packages(c("tidyverse", "ggrepel", "gganimate", "scales", "RColorBrewer", "DBI", "RPostgres"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(scales))
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(gganimate)

# 2. Andmebaasi ühenduse loomine (Asenda parameetrid oma PostgreSQL andmetega)
con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(),
                 dbname = "postgres",
                 host = "localhost",
                 port = 5432,
                 user = "postgres",
                 password = "andmed")

# 3. Andmete pärimine ja tabelite liitmine otse PostgreSQL andmebaasis läbi välisvõtmete
query <- "
SELECT 
    c.county_name,
    t.year_number,
    AVG(k.avg_price_m2)::NUMERIC(10,2) AS avg_price_m2,
    AVG(p.average_salary)::NUMERIC(10,2) AS avg_salary,
    SUM(k.transaction_count) AS total_transactions
FROM grupitoo_kv.fact_kv k
INNER JOIN grupitoo_kv.fact_palk p ON k.fk_quarter_id = p.fk_quarter_id AND k.fk_county_id = p.fk_county_id
INNER JOIN grupitoo_kv.dim_time t ON k.fk_quarter_id = t.pk_quarter_id
INNER JOIN grupitoo_kv.dim_county c ON k.fk_county_id = c.pk_county_id
GROUP BY c.county_name, t.year_number
ORDER BY c.county_name, t.year_number;
"

df_data <- dbGetQuery(con, query)
dbDisconnect(con) # Sulgeme ühenduse pärast andmete kättesaamist

# 4. Eriti Efektse Staatilise Visuaali Loomine (Trendijoonte ja mullidega)
visuaal_staatiline <- ggplot(df_data, aes(x = avg_salary, y = avg_price_m2, color = county_name)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = total_transactions), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = unit_format(unit = " €", sep = "")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = unit_format(unit = " €/m²", sep = "")) +
  scale_size_continuous(labels = comma, range = c(3, 12)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Kinnisvarahindade ja Keskmise Palga Seos Eestis",
    subtitle = "Maakondade pikaajaline makromajanduslik trajektoor (2005-2025)",
    x = "Keskmine Brutokuupalk (€)",
    y = "Korterite Keskmine Ruutmeetri Hind (€/m²)",
    color = "Maakond",
    size = "Tehinguaktiivsus (maht)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "#1a1a1a", margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "#555555", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, color = "#333333"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#f0f0f0"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  # Lisame viimase aasta sildid otse punktide juurde, et graafik oleks kergemini loetav
  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_data %>% group_by(county_name) %>% filter(year_number == max(year_number)),
    aes(label = county_name),
    fontface = "bold", size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE, box.padding = 0.5
  )

# Salvestame staatilise pildi kõrgresolutsioonis
ggsave("kinnisvara_vs_palk_staatiline.png", plot = visuaal_staatiline, width = 11, height = 7, dpi = 300)

# 5. Animeeritud Mullidiagrammi Loomine (Ajatelg liigub läbi aastate)
visuaal_animeeritud <- ggplot(df_data, aes(x = avg_salary, y = avg_price_m2, color = county_name, size = total_transactions)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(min(df_data$avg_salary)*0.9, max(df_data$avg_salary)*1.1), labels = unit_format(unit = " €", sep = "")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min(df_data$avg_price_m2)*0.9, max(df_data$avg_price_m2)*1.1), labels = unit_format(unit = " €/m²", sep = "")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 15), labels = comma) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, color = "#1a1a1a"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  # GGANIMATE dünaamilised sildid:
  labs(
    title = "Kinnisvaraturu ja palgakasvu dünaamika aastal: {frame_time}",
    x = "Keskmine brutopalk kvartalis",
    y = "Keskmine korteri m² hind",
    color = "Maakond",
    size = "Tehingute arv kokku"
  ) +
  transition_time(as.integer(year_number)) +
  ease_aes(''linear'') +
  shadow_wake(wake_length = 0.1, alpha = FALSE) # Jtab mullile väikese "saba", mis näitab liikumise suunda

# Salvestame animeeritud GIF faili
anim_save("kinnisvara_vs_palk_animatsioon.gif", animate(visuaal_animeeritud, width = 800, height = 600, fps = 10, duration = 15))'
